Scaffold a new dataset from CBS PDF documentation

Source: R/scaffold.R
cbs_scaffold_dataset.Rd

Generates skeleton YAML config files (manifest, codelists, column specs) for a new CBS dataset. Column definitions are extracted from PDF text files via cbs_parse_pdf_columns(). Character columns get random_categorical stubs; numeric columns get random_numeric stubs. Users then edit the generated YAML to refine distributions and codelists.

Usage

cbs_scaffold_dataset(
  dataset_id,
  label = dataset_id,
  files = list(),
  spine_builder = "generic",
  output_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

dataset_id

Short identifier for the dataset (e.g. "voertuigen").

label

Human-readable label (e.g. "CBS Voertuigen").

files

Named list of file definitions. Each element should be a list with:

cbs_name

CBS CamelCase dataset name

entity

Entity type: "person", "household", or "object"

txt_path

Path to extracted PDF text file (optional)

spine_builder

Spine builder type: "woonbase" (reads directly from the shared population spine) or "generic" (samples persons from the shared spine). Default "generic".

output_dir

Base output directory. Defaults to inst/config/datasets/{dataset_id} in the package source.

Value

Invisibly, the output directory path.
